insertions.section: 1. Start the campaign and choose how it will be sent
insertions.reader_goal: Full native technology-choice cards, SMS selected; other options keep their actual disabled/readiness state. Draft edit, not a New→wizard transition.
insertions.native_entry_proposed: campaign wizard edit, step technologies; native count frame
insertions.caption: Delivery options for a fictional campaign. SMS is selected and WhatsApp options retain their unavailable state.
insertions.alt: Campaign delivery options with SMS selected and WhatsApp options unavailable.
insertions.historical_anchor: The creator shows these options, but selecting one does not by itself enable sending: the business needs access and a ready sender for the chosen channel. The **Estimated target** is an approximation of audience size, not confirmation of how many profiles can receive the message.
insertions.current_anchor: The creator shows these options, but selecting one does not by itself enable sending: the business needs access and a ready sender for the chosen channel. The **Estimated target** updates to show how many customer profiles may be reachable through the selected delivery option.

insertions.historical_anchor: Usa el botón de agregar para combinar varias reglas de audiencia. Cambia **Incluir** por **Excluir** cuando un grupo deba quedar fuera de la campaña.
insertions.current_anchor: Con una selección específica, selecciona el nombre de un grupo agregado para alternar entre incluirlo y excluirlo. Los grupos excluidos muestran **Excluir** junto al nombre.

insertions.historical_anchor: Use the add button to combine multiple audience rules. Change **Include** to **Exclude** when a group should be removed from the campaign.
insertions.current_anchor: With a specific selection, select an added group's name to switch between including and excluding it. Excluded groups show **Exclude** beside their name.

insertions.historical_anchor: Usa el control de ajustes junto al **Target estimado** cuando quieras limitar la campaña a una cantidad máxima de clientes elegibles de la audiencia seleccionada. Este límite no vuelve contactable a un perfil que no sea elegible.
insertions.current_anchor: Usa el control de ajustes junto al **Alcance estimado** cuando quieras limitar la campaña a una cantidad máxima de clientes elegibles de la audiencia seleccionada. Este límite no vuelve contactable a un perfil que no sea elegible.

insertions.current_anchor: Use the settings control beside **Estimated target** when you want to limit the campaign to a maximum number of eligible customers from the selected audience. This limit does not make an ineligible profile contactable.

insertions.section: 4. Revisa la vista previa y envía una prueba
insertions.reader_goal: Native SMS test destination form visible; no number submission, Enter or send.
insertions.native_entry_proposed: DOM-only test popover; tests POST denied
insertions.caption: Formulario de prueba SMS con el campo de teléfono vacío y el botón de envío deshabilitado.
insertions.alt: Formulario Enviar mensaje a este número, con selector de país, campo de teléfono vacío y envío deshabilitado.
insertions.historical_anchor: Envía una prueba al destino que corresponda antes de continuar: un número que controles para SMS o WhatsApp, o una dirección propia para una campaña de solo correo. Una prueba por SMS puede entregarse directamente. Una prueba de WhatsApp con contenido nuevo puede quedar programada hasta que Meta apruebe la plantilla.
insertions.current_anchor: Envía una prueba al destino que corresponda antes de continuar: un número que controles para SMS o WhatsApp, o una dirección propia para una campaña de solo correo. Una prueba por SMS puede entregarse directamente. Una prueba de WhatsApp con contenido nuevo puede quedar programada hasta que Meta apruebe la plantilla.
insertions.instruction_addendum: Para una prueba SMS, en **Enviar mensaje a este número**, elige el país e ingresa un número que controles.

insertions.reader_goal: Native SMS test destination form visible; no number submission, Enter or send.

insertions.caption: SMS test form with an empty phone field and disabled send control.
insertions.alt: Send message to this number form with a country selector, empty phone field and disabled send control.
insertions.historical_anchor: Send a test to the appropriate destination before continuing: a number you control for SMS or WhatsApp, or your own address for an Email-only campaign. An SMS test can be delivered directly. A WhatsApp test with new template content can remain scheduled until Meta approves that template.
insertions.current_anchor: Send a test to the appropriate destination before continuing: a number you control for SMS or WhatsApp, or your own address for an Email-only campaign. An SMS test can be delivered directly. A WhatsApp test with new template content can remain scheduled until Meta approves that template.
insertions.instruction_addendum: For an SMS test, in **Send message to this number**, choose the country and enter a number you control.

insertions.current_anchor: Hellotext aplica las ventanas de comunicación requeridas para el país de destino y los ajustes de horas nocturnas del negocio. Si el momento elegido no está permitido, la interfaz puede solicitar otro horario o mover la entrega a la siguiente ventana permitida.

scope: Editorial candidates, not an image quota or source acceptance. Actual UI geometry may require split crops or make a candidate unusable. No placeholder figures inserted.
acceptance: Admit real localized UI PNGs with observed native DPR/scale, exact clip and Display P3 profile; never postprocess pixels or invent states.
Derive CSS caps from actual native logical size. Inspect individual sources, all six complete Help views and every detail at1440/580/390.
Static nonlinked figures retain the standard lavender stage and separate white inset.
Captions identify fictional data and actual state; provenance records direct draft entry and actions not performed.
Preserve real payment/readiness requirements; never imply test, approval, payment, scheduling or delivery happened.
